title: Product category
description: JSON Schema for a product category C × D — the category whose objects are pairs (c, d) with c in Ob(C) and d in Ob(D), and whose morphisms (c, d) → (c', d') are pairs (f, g) with f : c → c' in C and g : d → d' in D (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. II §3). Specializes category by carrying a factors array of categories being multiplied. uniqueItems: true on factors enforces distinct factors.

factors.description: The categories being multiplied. At least two; usually two for the binary case, more for n-ary products of categories.
